scope: Source and existing automated coverage audit; current PR conclusions supersede pending coverage labels

features.actual_behavior: Recent projects, latest media, create/import/camera/template/help routes; async loading and retry
features.persistence: Theme/onboarding prefs; recent projects from repository
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Recent loading can move content; tests wait for completion
features.recommended_fix: Retain stable loading and error states; profile long lists before further redesign

features.actual_behavior: Native loading/retry/settings fallback until commit, nonzero layout and draw; 10s watchdog
features.persistence: No blocking initialization on first frame
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Cannot recover blocked main thread/GPU or async Compose crash; original API37 black screen not reproduced here
features.recommended_fix: Obtain supported API37 image when available; retain logs and do not infer Android17 success from API35

features.navigation: Bottom tabs + Settings + nested editor workspaces
features.actual_behavior: Save before leaving native editor; failed save keeps editor; Back closes overlays then returns Home
features.persistence: Selected tab and active native project ID saveable; nested disclosure/form state mostly in memory
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Every individual control has not been exercised; process recreation of all in-progress forms is unverified; rapid competing navigation requests need stress testing
features.recommended_fix: Add focused recreation/race cases before claiming complete state restoration

features.navigation: Home Create/Import, Library Open in Studio, Studio New video project
features.actual_behavior: SAF local video MIME/duration validation; project/source URI retained; images/audio use legacy tools
features.persistence: Project JSON and SAF grants; provider may revoke source
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Native video composition has no image clip timeline; OS/provider can remove media
features.recommended_fix: Use explicit relink and durable document sources; never represent legacy image tools as image timeline

features.navigation: Studio native editor → timeline and clip controls
features.actual_behavior: Seek/zoom/drag reorder; split/trim/duplicate/remove; merge adjacent same-source ranges
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: One sequential video lane; 12 clip / 30 minute limits; no simultaneous PiP/split-screen tracks
features.recommended_fix: Keep limits visible; multivideo compositing is future feature work

features.actual_behavior: Bounded 50 snapshots with grouped continuous edits
features.persistence: Session only; persisted project is current state
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: History not serialized across process death
features.recommended_fix: Document session-only history; current project remains saved

features.actual_behavior: MONO/invert, brightness/contrast/saturation, fade-to-black edges, crop/rotate/aspect and discrete speed
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: No cross-dissolve between overlapping video clips or continuous speed ramps
features.recommended_fix: Keep supported labels; avoid unsupported transition promises

features.actual_behavior: Music/voiceover gain; four offset/trimmed lanes with fades and original audio speed sync
features.persistence: Project URIs/parameters; recorded voice files private
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Real microphone capture/route quality not hardware-tested; waveforms and advanced EQ absent
features.recommended_fix: Validate microphone capture and interruptions on user hardware; retain URI validation

features.navigation: Editor overlay/caption tools; Creative manual return
features.actual_behavior: Timed text with font/color/size/Y position; SRT parse/export; burn into render
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: No imported-video transcription or word-level karaoke alignment
features.recommended_fix: Use manual/SRT captions; do not label dictation as video transcription

features.navigation: Editor save; Studio project list; Settings Privacy recovery
features.actual_behavior: Atomic saves, stale-write guard, copy/confirm trash/restore/relink; last-good recovery as copy
features.persistence: Private versioned JSON; backup/recovery files; originals preserved
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Sprint8 fixes oversize serialization that previously produced unreadable project files; recovery/trash have no storage quota
features.recommended_fix: Reject before touching current/recovery; use reference-aware cleanup only in a future explicit workflow

features.actual_behavior: Media3 H264/AAC; HD/FHD/UHD options, FPS/bitrate, progress/foreground worker, fingerprint stale guard
features.persistence: Immutable WorkManager request + output record + MediaStore
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: 4K depends on encoder; exactly-once MediaStore publication after process death not guaranteed; Sprint8 QA found redundant FPS dropper tail truncation: source-rate-aware bypass plus unchanged/stronger real-output assertions added, final CI required
features.recommended_fix: Verify final cadence/tail and higher-rate downsample regressions; preserve encoder support limits and durable publication follow-up

features.actual_behavior: Existing cloud story/sticker/status rendering and local segmentation; stale derivative guard
features.persistence: Media records and source media; cloud derivatives require service
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Separate native and cloud paths overlap in purpose but differ capabilities; cloud service not exercised
features.recommended_fix: Preserve named legacy tools until native replacement covers behavior; do not silently switch offline tools to cloud

features.navigation: Home Quick Camera / Camera tab / Studio camera
features.actual_behavior: CameraX photo/video, front/rear switching, flash/zoom/timer; concurrent-camera mode only if advertised
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Synthetic result routing tested only; physical sensors, flash, mic, camera denial and recording interruption not verified
features.recommended_fix: User device test camera capture and codecs; retain capability gating

features.actual_behavior: Validate local URI/media type and register capture; video opens editor, image uses media tools
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: No hardware capture-to-render end-to-end claim
features.recommended_fix: Test full hardware path later without manual screenshot dependency

features.actual_behavior: Search/type/filter/sort/grid/list/favorites/rename/bulk/delete/share/report; previews
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Native projects live in Studio/Home rather than Library media grid; large libraries not exhaustively profiled
features.recommended_fix: Keep project/media distinction; paginate only after measurement demonstrates need

features.navigation: Library media cards → preview; Home media
features.actual_behavior: ExoPlayer audio/video and image preview; bounded 320px thumbnail decode, 8MiB LRU/two concurrent decodes
features.persistence: Memory thumbnail cache; no durable bitmap guarantee
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Compose bitmap lifetime repair inherited from S7; URI revocation possible
features.recommended_fix: Retain framework-owned bitmap lifetime; show failure without recycling a still-visible bitmap

features.actual_behavior: Content URI with MIME, ClipData/read permission; stale native export disabled
features.persistence: Published media survives editor changes; share itself external
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: External recipient apps and completed human Sharesheet send not automated
features.recommended_fix: Validate chosen target on user device; no social-upload or recipient delivery claim

features.navigation: Home Download links / Downloads panel / text share inbox
features.actual_behavior: Public URL inspection, video/audio quality tiers and remembered format
features.coverage: source audit only
features.defects_or_limits: Service/network/extractor dependent; no live production download smoke in this sprint
features.recommended_fix: Use existing mocked/backend regression; owner must validate public endpoint separately

features.actual_behavior: Progress/cancel/retry/pause/resume with saved job metadata; batch max10; Wi-Fi-only preference
features.coverage: source audit only
features.defects_or_limits: Pause/resume does not guarantee byte-range continuation for every provider; server jobs may expire
features.recommended_fix: Report provider support accurately; do not promise universally resumable transfers

features.navigation: Android text share → Inbox → Downloads → Open in Studio
features.actual_behavior: Normalize URL, persist inbox entry, route completed local media into Studio
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Text links only; arbitrary external media deep link is not a supported route
features.recommended_fix: Keep exported intent surface narrow; validate future media intake explicitly

features.actual_behavior: Real decoded frames/PCM: scenes, exposure, silence, highlights, static face framing/soft focus; cancellable
features.persistence: Derived projects saved locally; analysis session memory
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Deterministic heuristics, not generative AI; limited analysis span; no tracking model
features.recommended_fix: Disclose local heuristic scope and source-preserving derived cuts

features.actual_behavior: Local topic rules generate suggested titles/hooks/script/hashtags; apply editable text
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: No LLM, cloud inference or originality/virality guarantee
features.recommended_fix: Label local suggestions; no paid inference added

features.navigation: Home template shortcut / Creative templates / Social recipes
features.actual_behavior: Recipes create editable projects from current/imported media; relink/replace supported sources
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Creative and Social recipe catalogs intentionally differ; no remote marketplace
features.recommended_fix: Retain shared StudioProject/renderer; consolidate only genuinely equivalent presentation later

features.actual_behavior: Provider-dependent live microphone dictation and optional English model request; manual caption fallback
features.persistence: Applied captions saved; recognizer availability external
features.coverage: source audit only
features.defects_or_limits: No bundled model, imported-media STT or universal offline English availability
features.recommended_fix: Treat model request as OS-managed; no model purchase or automatic cloud fallback

features.actual_behavior: Canvas frame/text/subtitle/badge/color/font positioning; save/reopen; publish hashed PNG
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: No asset portability bundle; source read access can expire
features.recommended_fix: Keep explicit relink/storage limitations; PNG is a real independent export

features.actual_behavior: 16:9/9:16/1:1/4:5/4:3 output, fit/fill, graphics, captions, watermark/progress
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: No platform account integration/automatic upload; codec support varies
features.recommended_fix: Use Android sharing; do not claim platform publishing

features.actual_behavior: Private bounded logo import, colors/font/watermark/intro/outro; apply editable snapshot
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Unused historical logo assets may remain; project portability unresolved
features.recommended_fix: Reference-aware asset cleanup later; never delete assets still referenced by projects

features.actual_behavior: Serial native exports, progress/cancel/retry/reuse identical successful output
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Interrupted process/publication reconciliation not fully fault-injected; failed predecessor needs retry
features.recommended_fix: Reconcile durable publication before promising exactly-once recovery

features.actual_behavior: Manual BPM grid, jump cuts, stepped 0.5/1/2x derived timeline
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: No automatic musical beat detection or continuous optical-flow ramps
features.recommended_fix: Keep manual/stepped labels explicit

features.actual_behavior: All current entitlements free; guest APK excludes Firebase runtime; projects independent of account
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: No cloud backup or account-to-account project sync
features.recommended_fix: Do not imply sign-in backs up local files; keep guest path complete

features.actual_behavior: Firebase email/password/register/reset/profile/logout/reauth+delete; SDK-managed session
features.persistence: Firebase SDK session; no app password/token copies
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: UI tests use fake service; demo-config compile is not live Auth verification; #64 is independent
features.recommended_fix: Owner-configured auth emulator/service validation required; no production provisioning in sprint

features.actual_behavior: Off-by-default optional analytics/crash choices; persist before enable; on failure attempt disable and persist withdrawal; guest SDK absent
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Sprint8 repairs SDK-before-commit ordering. Live delivery unverified; permanent disk/SDK disable failure cannot guarantee persistent withdrawal.
features.recommended_fix: Use injected failure regressions; real configured service/consent propagation must be verified separately

features.actual_behavior: Measured private storage; thumbnail-only cleanup; no symlink traversal; confirm trash and recover as copy
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: Cache clearing cannot reclaim recordings/recovery/brand files safely without reference tracking
features.recommended_fix: Retain narrow cleanup; never sweep active cache/imports/exports

features.navigation: Settings disclosures; Help; Android settings links
features.actual_behavior: Consistent theme, download/export prefs, notification/accessibility/permission Settings links and onboarding
features.coverage: automated cases listed; final run conclusions in PR #69
features.defects_or_limits: No full TalkBack contrast audit or every device font scale certification
features.recommended_fix: User a11y/device testing remains; existing large-font Home test only

features.actual_behavior: No implemented simultaneous video tracks, PiP, cloud project collaboration, portable project archive or cloud backups
features.coverage: source audit only
features.defects_or_limits: Unimplemented; legacy CollaborativeStash/GhostPlayer scaffolds are not a supported feature
features.recommended_fix: Keep out of release claims; future feature expansion requires real models/renderers/tests
